safety_lead_time.comparison_action: Decrease SAP safety lead time from 4.0 to 2.4 days

narrative: Material PL2__M4EFC828 exhibits variable demand (CV=0.63) with moderate lead time stability (CV=0.26). A classical (r,Q) EOQ policy with Normal-proxy safety stock is selected; storage capacity at 3,843 units binds the order quantity below the unconstrained EOQ of 4,653 units, resulting in a final Q of 2,739 units. The current SAP safety stock of 0 is critically insufficient — 1,103 units are required to achieve the 95% service level. Reducing the SAP safety lead time from 4.0 to 2.4 days is also recommended.
warnings: Order quantity constrained by storage capacity: reduced from 4653 to 2739 units

research_insights.selected_model: Classical EOQ with safety stock — (r,Q) fixed-reorder-point policy
research_insights.selection_rationale: Variable demand (CV=0.63) with moderately stable lead times suits a Normal-proxy lead-time-demand safety stock model and an EOQ replenishment cycle. Intermittency is low (92.6% non-zero days), supporting the Normal approximation.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity constraint is binding — order quantity reduced from EOQ-optimal 4,653 to 2,739 units. This increases ordering frequency and raises total annual cost by ~$1,325. A capacity expansion of ~800 units would unlock the full EOQ benefit.
research_insights.escalation_flag: MEDIUM — Storage constraint active; recommend reviewing warehouse capacity allocation and exploring MOQ renegotiation with supplier.
